final: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT ID, AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0 THEN 1.0 * HGB / HCT END) AS avg_ratio, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS cross_patient_avg FROM patient_stats WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_average_pic, AVG(p.avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio, AVG(p.avg_ratio - o.cross_patient_avg) AS mean_excess_over_cross_patient_average FROM patient_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.cross_patient_avg
